mapper.sql: select p.price_id, p.gun_id, p.price, p.effective_from, p.effective_to, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.remark, g.gun_no, g.gas_type, g.station_id, s.station_name, b.buyer_name from gas_gun_price p left join gas_gun g on p.gun_id = g.gun_id left join gas_station s on g.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_buyer b on s.buyer_id = b.buyer_id
mapper.select: where p.gun_id = #{gunId} and p.effective_from <= now() and (p.effective_to is null or p.effective_to > now()) order by p.effective_from desc limit 1
where p.gun_id = #{gunId} and p.effective_to is null order by p.effective_from desc limit 1
mapper.update: update gas_gun_price set effective_to = #{effectiveTo} where gun_id = #{gunId} and effective_to is null
mapper.select: where p.gun_id = #{gunId} and p.effective_from < #{effectiveFrom} order by p.effective_from desc limit 1
select count(1) from gas_gun_price where gun_id = #{gunId} and effective_from > #{effectiveFrom}
mapper.update: update gas_gun_price set effective_to = null where price_id = #{priceId}
mapper.insert: insert into gas_gun_price( gun_id, price, effective_from, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{gunId}, #{price}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
